remarks: You will love coming home to this spacious 2 bedroom 2.5 bath beautiful townhouse. Enjoy easy living by parking in your attached garage and heading up to your personal oasis. The entrance foyer, powder room and open floor plan all welcome both you and your guests. Cozy up by your wood burning fireplace on cold winter nights, and enjoy outdoor dining in the summertime on your attached deck. The updated kitchen has a large center island, stainless appliances, pantry and storage galore. A new washer and dryer are located in the hallway right outside both bedrooms, and there is even an easily accessible attic for more storage. Both the primary and second bedroom each have their own private bath. There is an additional storage room off the garage, and the complex pool is just steps away from your front door to keep you cool and relaxed all summer long! The super convenient location is just minutes away to the direct trains into Manhattan. the Merritt & I-95. Shopping, dining, the beach and entertainment are all nearby. Now is the time to enjoy the benefits of home ownership in this perfect spot for first time buyers or down-sizers alike!
